rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for dividing items among people or handing things out, such as bread or flyers.

example.english: We distribute bread to the residents.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 paai3 di1 min6 baau1 bei2 gaai1 fong1

rows.note: Use this for spreading a load, force, or weight across several points or a wider area rather than giving items to people.

example.english: This mat can distribute the weight.
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 dim3 ho2 ji5 fan1 saan3 zung6 loeng6

rows.note: Use this in business contexts when goods or publications are supplied through retail outlets.

example.english: We distribute this magazine to major bookstores across Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 我哋公司分銷呢本雜誌到全港各大書店。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 fan1 siu1 ni1 bun2 zaap6 zi3 dou3 cyun4 gong2 gok3 daai6 syu1 dim3

rows.note: Use this when scattering loose material such as grass seed over an area.

example.english: In spring, farmers distribute grass seed over the fields.
example.traditional: 春天，農夫會喺田入面撒草籽。
example.jyutping: ceon1 tin1 nung4 fu1 wui5 hai2 tin4 jap6 min6 saat3 cou2 zi2
